title: Butcher Shop, Week 4
dek: Chris Olave has 36 targets and one touchdown. That price will not last, so go get him today.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Fri 5:00 PM ET: Justin Jefferson is ruled out vs MIA and stays a buy at WR5 rest of season; Puka Nacua has no designation with McVay limiting his snaps; Nico Collins practiced Friday; Ladd McConkey missed Thursday and is questionable, and the buy calls stand.

Updated Thu 10:45 PM ET: added Justin Jefferson, Puka Nacua, Nico Collins, Jalen Hurts, Chase Brown, Malik Nabers, Colston Loveland, Tucker Kraft, Ladd McConkey and Breece Hall as buys, and Derrick Henry, Davante Adams, Jaylen Warren, David Montgomery, Michael Wilson, Mark Andrews, Kyler Murray and Kalif Raymond as sells. Omarion Hampton is RB12 rest of season for me, so the ask goes up to a top-15 RB who catches passes or a WR2.

Updated Wed 3:45 PM ET: Omarion Hampton's snap share has gone 58, 63 and 42 percent; the sell call stands.

Updated Wed 2:20 PM ET: Klint Kubiak said Monday that Mike Washington Jr. earned more opportunities, Ashton Jeanty's last 40 carries went for 104 yards and he visited the trainers @NO; the trade-for call on Jeanty stands, with the first-half carry split vs KC as the check.

Three weeks in, the box scores and the usage are telling two different stories, and the trade market reads the box scores. The buys below are getting the ball and not the points yet. The sells are getting the points without the ball, or are about to lose the role. Every price is written for 12-team PPR leagues; scale it to your league.
outro_md: Heat Check has the usage trends behind these calls, and the Menu lands Wednesday with every one of them ranked.

buy.price: a WR2 and a bench RB
buy.why: Jefferson sprained his ankle in Week 3 and finished with 2 catches for 32 on 7 snaps, then missed every practice and was ruled out Friday vs MIA. The sprain is not a high one and Kevin O'Connell still calls him day to day, so his manager is selling a one-week scare.
buy.verdict: He is WR5 rest of season for me. Trade for him while he sits this week; offer a WR2 and a bench RB.

buy.why: Nacua has not played since Week 1 with the groin. He has no designation for Sunday @PHI, though Sean McVay said his snaps may be limited, and Davante Adams drew 13 targets on 57 routes @DEN with him out.
buy.verdict: He is WR6 rest of season for me. Trade for him before a full game shows the price; offer a WR2.

buy.why: Collins missed Weeks 2 and 3 with a grade 1 hamstring strain, was limited Wednesday and Thursday and practiced Friday. Kayshon Boutte led the Houston receivers at 69 percent of the snaps in Week 3 without him.
buy.verdict: He is WR8 rest of season for me. Trade for him before he plays vs DAL; offer a WR2.

buy.price: a QB in the 8 to 12 range and a bench WR
buy.why: Hurts has run 16 times for 87 yards in three games and threw for 153 in the 7-point game @CHI, where he was checked for a concussion, cleared and missed four snaps. The box score has his managers nervous, and the rushing is the part that comes back.
buy.verdict: He is QB3 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a QB in the 8 to 12 range and a bench WR.

buy.price: a WR2 and a bench RB
buy.why: Olave has 13, 10 and 13 targets in three games, 36 in all, with 27 catches for 375 yards. He has one touchdown, and he nearly scored three times vs LV in Week 3.
buy.verdict: He is WR7 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2 and a bench RB.

buy.price: a RB2 and a bench WR
buy.why: Brown has 49 carries for 197 yards and 1 rushing touchdown in three games, and he kept 13 of the 16 back carries @PIT, where all three Cincinnati touchdowns were passes. Samaje Perine took 3 of the 5 back targets in that game, and that is the discount.
buy.verdict: He is RB6 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a RB2 and a bench WR.

buy.price: a low-end WR1 or a RB1 with a shakier role
buy.why: Jeanty has topped 20 touches in all three games with 63 of the two backs' 78 carries and all 16 targets, but his last 40 carries went for 104 yards (2.6 a carry), he has no rushing touchdown, and he visited the trainers @NO. Klint Kubiak said Monday that Mike Washington Jr., who has 15 carries for 102 yards, earned more opportunities, the second time he has said it, and that is the discount.
buy.verdict: Trade for him; offer a low-end WR1 or a RB1 whose role is less secure, and watch the first-half carry split vs KC before you go higher.

buy.price: a WR2 or a RB2 who is scoring touchdowns
buy.why: Barkley has zero touchdowns in three games, and a stinger held him to 12 snaps and 4 carries in Week 2. He was healthy @CHI and ran 15 times for 82 yards, 73 of them on 11 first-half carries.
buy.verdict: He is RB9 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2 or a RB2 who has been living on touchdowns.

buy.price: a WR3 and a bench RB
buy.why: Nabers drew 6 of Jameis Winston's 22 targets in the nor'easter vs TEN, a 27 percent share, but they came at an average depth of 1.0 yards and went for 26. His average depth the week before was 20.5.
buy.verdict: He is WR13 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.

buy.price: a TE in the 12 to 16 range or a bench WR
buy.why: Loveland has run a route on 71 percent of the dropbacks but has 5 catches for 34 yards on 9 targets in three games, and a 6-yard touchdown vs PHI was overturned at the goal line. Those are a starting tight end's routes with a backup quarterback's targets.
buy.verdict: He is TE5 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a TE in the 12 to 16 range or a bench WR.

buy.price: a TE in the 10 to 14 range
buy.why: Kraft drew 8 targets on 39 routes vs ATL in Week 3 but caught 4 for 26 with two drops, and he has 9 catches on 17 targets this season. Jayden Reed is out for the season after neck surgery, which frees up the short throws.
buy.verdict: He is TE6 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a TE in the 10 to 14 range.

buy.why: McConkey played 49 and 46 percent of the snaps around a rib injury, then 88 percent @BUF in Week 3, and he has 12 catches for 183 on 15 targets. A new foot injury had him limited Wednesday, out of practice Thursday and questionable @SEA, which keeps the price down.
buy.verdict: He is WR23 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

buy.price: a RB3 who plays this week and a bench WR
buy.why: Hall hurt his quad on a goal-line carry @DET in Week 3, and the MRI showed nothing long term. He missed practice Wednesday and Thursday and Aaron Glenn calls him week to week, so his manager is looking at a zero this week.
buy.verdict: He is RB15 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a RB3 who plays this week and a bench WR.

buy.price: a bench WR or a QB2
buy.why: Love has thrown 124 passes in three games, about 41 a game, with 6 touchdowns and 2 interceptions. His 52.4 percent completion rate is the ugly number, and it is why his managers will take a bench piece.
buy.verdict: He is QB12 for me this week @TB, a borderline start. Trade for him if you need a QB; offer a bench WR or your QB2.

sell.price: a top-8 RB or a WR1
sell.why: Henry has 6 touchdowns in three games, but he ran 26 times for 89 vs DAL in Rio, his 11 inside runs went for 23 and he was stopped on two fourth-and-1 runs. Both Baltimore centers went down in that game and a rookie guard is snapping, and the touchdown pace is what sets his price.
sell.verdict: He is RB10 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a top-8 RB or a WR1.

sell.price: a WR2 whose targets do not depend on an injury
sell.why: Adams caught 8 of 10 for 195 and 2 touchdowns vs NYG and drew 13 targets on 57 routes @DEN, both games without Puka Nacua. Nacua practiced Wednesday for the first time in about two weeks and Sean McVay expects him back.
sell.verdict: He is WR22 rest of season for me. Trade him away now; ask for a WR2 whose targets do not depend on an injury.

sell.price: a TE with a steady target share, or a WR3
sell.why: Ferguson has 3 touchdowns on 11 targets: 2 in Week 1, 4 in Week 2 and 5 in Week 3, with 9 catches for 72 yards. His snap share went 76, 60 and 69 percent while Brevyn Spann-Ford's rose from 22 to 38 percent.
sell.verdict: He is TE16 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a TE with a steady target share or a WR3.

sell.price: a RB2 with a role that lasts past Week 7
sell.why: Jones has led the Vikings backfield only since Jordan Mason went on IR with a fractured thumb, and Mason is eligible to return in Week 7. Jones had 22 touches @TB in Week 3 but ran 17 times for 58 yards, and he practiced through a knee issue before that game.
sell.verdict: He is RB13 for me this week vs MIA, borderline RB1/RB2, and RB30 rest of season. Trade him away after Sunday, before Mason is back; ask for a RB2 with a role that lasts past Week 7.

sell.price: a RB2 with a three-down role
sell.why: Warren played 90 percent of the snaps in Week 3 with Rico Dowdle inactive and turned 20 touches into 176 yards. Dowdle (toe) was ruled out again for Thursday @CLE, and the work splits once he is back.
sell.verdict: He is RB27 rest of season for me. Trade him away after Thursday's game; ask for a RB2 with a three-down role.

sell.price: a top-15 RB who catches passes, or a WR2
sell.why: Hampton's snap share has gone 58, 63 and 42 percent, so the fall is from Week 2, not from an 80 percent start. He ran 6 routes @BUF to 14 for Keaton Mitchell and 13 for Kimani Vidal, and he has 3 targets all season, so the passing-down work is gone.
sell.verdict: He is RB12 rest of season for me on the carries, and the routes are going away. Trade him away while his name still sells; ask for a top-15 RB who catches passes or a WR2.

sell.price: a RB2 who leads his backfield
sell.why: Montgomery has 37 carries for 103 yards, 2.8 a carry, and he has been hit at or behind the line on 68 percent of his runs, the most in the league. Woody Marks has 50 routes to his 56 and scored Houston's goal-line touchdown at IND, and the snaps were about even in Weeks 1 and 2.
sell.verdict: He is RB18 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a RB2 who leads his backfield.

sell.price: a WR2 in a steadier offense
sell.why: Egbuka drew a season-high 9 targets vs MIN in Week 3, but Baker Mayfield dislocated his throwing thumb and is out at least three weeks. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts vs GB, and he went 0 for 3 in relief.
sell.verdict: He is WR21 rest of season for me, and the next three weeks are the rookie's. Trade him away this week; ask for a WR2 in a steadier offense.

sell.price: a WR3 with a steadier role and a bench RB
sell.why: Wilson has 31 targets in three games, but 17 of them came in the 36-30 loss @SF, when Arizona dropped back 54 times. He has caught 58 percent of his targets for 163 yards.
sell.verdict: He is WR43 rest of season for me, so sell the target count. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 with a steadier role and a bench RB.

sell.price: a TE in the 8 to 12 range
sell.why: Andrews played 33 of 64 snaps vs DAL in Rio, the same number as Durham Smythe, and caught 3 of 5 for 24 after hurting his hand in the second quarter. An even split with Smythe caps his routes.
sell.verdict: He is TE14 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a TE in the 8 to 12 range.

sell.price: a steadier QB2 and a bench WR
sell.why: Murray went 15 of 29 for 168, 5.8 a throw, with 1 touchdown, 1 interception and 3 sacks @TB in his first full game for Minnesota, and the offense scored one touchdown. Justin Jefferson missed practice Wednesday and Thursday with the ankle.
sell.verdict: He is QB19 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a steadier QB2 and a bench WR.

sell.price: a bench RB with a role
sell.why: Raymond leads the Bears with 214 yards on 21 targets, a 23 percent share, while running a route on 66 percent of the dropbacks. Luther Burden III has a 25 percent share and more of the routes, and the backup quarterbacks are starting.
sell.verdict: He is WR76 rest of season for me. Trade him away while the yards look good; ask for a bench RB with a role.
